description: Alert when an entire selection of assets has gone silent, as one check result instead of hundreds of per-asset alerts. Polls the most recent materialization (or observation) across a whole selection and reports a single AssetCheckEvaluation against a declared rollup asset -- distinct from post_processing's per-asset attributes.freshness_policy, which answers 'is this one asset stale' rather than 'did the whole feed stop'.

outputs.description: One passed/failed check per tick against the declared rollup asset -- wire a Dagster+ 'asset check failed' alert policy to it.

monitored_selection.label: Monitored Selection
monitored_selection.description: Asset selection to monitor in aggregate: explicit key list, the Dagster selection DSL (tag:/group:/kind:/boolean composition), '*' for everything, or a bare fnmatch glob. Resolved against discovered assets in monitored_folder (default: this component's own parent defs folder).

monitored_folder.label: Monitored Folder
monitored_folder.description: Override which folder monitored_selection resolves against, as a path relative to this component's own folder (e.g. '../other_scenario'). Defaults to this component's immediate parent folder. Do NOT set to '.' to search this component's own folder when co-locating it as a second --- separated YAML document inside the same defs.yaml as a dagster.DefsFolderComponent -- that causes a real RecursionError, not something this field can fix.

rollup_asset_key.label: Rollup Asset Key
rollup_asset_key.description: Asset key for the single declared 'rollup' asset the aggregate check is reported against (e.g. 'sap_ecc/hourly_feed_health'). Declare-only -- this component never materializes it, it only exists to carry the check.

max_silence_seconds.label: Max Silence Seconds
max_silence_seconds.description: Fail the aggregate check if the most recent materialization across the WHOLE monitored selection is older than this many seconds -- or if nothing in the selection has ever materialized at all.

check_name.label: Check Name
check_name.description: Name of the asset check reported against rollup_asset_key.

include_observations.label: Include Observations
include_observations.description: Also consider AssetObservation events (not just materializations) when finding the most recent event per monitored asset. Costs one extra query per monitored asset per tick, so it's opt-in -- leave off for large selections unless some monitored assets are observation-only.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: 'running' or 'stopped' -- initial status of the sensor.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Group name for the declared rollup asset.

description.label: Description
description.description: Description for the declared rollup asset.

name: Aggregate Freshness Sensor
